title: dendrobium × nitidum
intro: Dendrobium × nitidum, commonly known as the Orchid Dendrobium, is a hybrid orchid species known for its beautiful and fragrant flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium × nitidum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to include flavonoids such as flavanones, flavonols, and flavanols, as well as alkaloids and phenolic acids.
